## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and compatibility impact.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run test:pack`
- [ ] Relevant eval or benchmark command
- [ ] Documentation and Changelog updated when needed

## Safety

- [ ] No private wiki content or generated index data is included
- [ ] Plain MCP `serve` remains read-only
- [ ] Stable MCP tool names are unchanged, or a migration is documented
